description: Create backend API endpoints for live match center. Extend existing live_matches.py endpoint to include SportScore provider. Create new endpoints for live match detail (/matches/{id}/live), live events (/matches/{id}/live/events), live lineups (/matches/{id}/live/lineups), live statistics (/matches/{id}/live/stats). Add Pydantic response schemas. Integrate with SportScore provider. Write API tests.
steps: Read backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/live_matches.py to understand existing live matches endpoint structure, LiveMatchesResponse schema, provider health service integration
Read backend/app/api/v1/__init__.py to understand router registration pattern
Read backend/app/domain/live.py to understand LiveMatchState model
Extend backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/live_matches.py: Add SportScore provider instantiation in get_live_matches() function alongside Ryzellx, FotMob, OpenLigaDB
Update ProviderManager initialization to include sportscore parameter, pass to manager
Create backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/live_detail.py: Import FastAPI router, Pydantic models, SportScore provider
Define LiveMatchDetailResponse schema: match_id, provider, status, minute, added_time, period, home_score, away_score, home_team, away_team, competition, live_statistics, data_quality, timestamp
Implement GET /matches/{match_id}/live endpoint: Instantiate SportScore provider, call get_live_match_state(match_id), return LiveMatchDetailResponse or 404 if not found
Define LiveEventsResponse schema: match_id, events List[LiveEvent] with type, minute, added_time, team, player_name, description
Implement GET /matches/{match_id}/live/events endpoint: Call sportscore.get_match_events(match_id), normalize to LiveEvent objects, return LiveEventsResponse
Define LiveLineupsResponse schema: match_id, home_lineup (formation, starting_xi, substitutes), away_lineup (formation, starting_xi, substitutes)
Implement GET /matches/{match_id}/live/lineups endpoint: Call sportscore.get_match_lineups(match_id), return LiveLineupsResponse
Define LiveStatisticsResponse schema: match_id, home_stats (possession, shots, shots_on_target, corners, fouls, yellow_cards, red_cards), away_stats (same fields)
Implement GET /matches/{match_id}/live/stats endpoint: Extract statistics from live match state, return LiveStatisticsResponse with None for unavailable fields
Register new router in backend/app/api/v1/__init__.py: api_router.include_router(live_detail.router) (ensure ordering: live_matches, live_detail, then matches)

Create backend/tests/api/test_live_endpoints.py: Test GET /matches/live returns 200 with SportScore in provider list, test GET /matches/{id}/live returns LiveMatchDetailResponse, test 404 for non-existent match, test error handling
Run API tests: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/api/test_live_endpoints.py -v, fix failures

Manually test endpoints: Start FastAPI server (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload), use curl or browser to test /api/v1/matches/live, /api/v1/matches/{some_id}/live, verify JSON responses
Commit: 'feat(api): add live match center endpoints with SportScore integration'
acceptance_criteria: backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/live_matches.py updated to include SportScore provider in get_live_matches()
GET /api/v1/matches/{id}/live endpoint returns LiveMatchDetailResponse with live match state
GET /api/v1/matches/{id}/live/events endpoint returns LiveEventsResponse with match events timeline
GET /api/v1/matches/{id}/live/lineups endpoint returns LiveLineupsResponse with formations and players
GET /api/v1/matches/{id}/live/stats endpoint returns LiveStatisticsResponse with live statistics
All endpoints return 404 with error detail when match not found
All endpoints handle provider errors gracefully (log error, return 500 with error message)
Pydantic schemas validate all response data (no runtime validation errors)
backend/tests/api/test_live_endpoints.py created with at least 6 test cases
All API tests pass: pytest tests/api/test_live_endpoints.py returns 0 exit code
Manual testing confirms endpoints return valid JSON and FastAPI /docs shows new endpoints
